claims: IOS 26.4 introduces new skin tone variations for dancers and wrestling emojis.
The emoji updates were finalized in March 2026.
The Distorted Face emoji is a melting or skewed face.
The Fight Cloud emoji is a cartoon-style dust cloud indicating a fight.
The Ballet Dancer emoji 🧑‍🩰 is a gender-neutral dancer with skin tone options.
The Orca emoji is a killer whale emoji.
The Hairy Creature emoji is a Sasquatch or Bigfoot-like figure.
The Trombone emoji is a musical instrument.
The Landslide emoji is a scene showing rocks tumbling.
The Treasure Chest emoji is a chest filled with jewels.
New skin tone modifiers are available for the people wrestling emoji.
New skin tone modifiers are available for the dancer with bunny ears emoji.
The new emoji characters were finalized by the Unicode Consortium.
The new emoji characters were added to Apple's keyboard in the iOS 26.4 release.
